snippet.title: Blood: Refreshed Supply - Reveal Trailer | Nightdive Studios
snippet.description:
Refresh your supply of Blood with Blood: Refreshed Supply coming to PC and consoles (for the first time ever) later this year! Not only will you finally be able to enjoy Blood on consoles, you'll also be able to sink your teeth into brand-new content and community mods, including the multi-episode Marrow and Death Wish scenarios.

Blood: Refreshed Supply is coming soon to PC and console platforms, including Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch.
===================================
Blood: Refreshed Supply
— Available for Pre-Order on PC  —
===================================
🟡 Steam: https://bit.ly/BRS_Steam
🟣 GOG: https://bit.ly/BRS_GOG

🟢 Xbox: https://bit.ly/BRS_Xbox
